[ BETA ]
Loot. Craft. Fight. Survive.
The blocky world has fallen to zombies, and Haven is the last safe town. Gear up and fight your way to Ground Zero!

🎒 Loot gear that shows up on your character
🔨 Craft and upgrade your weapons
🧟 Explore 9 zones and beat their bosses
🤝 Team up with friends — no PvP, every drop is yours

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to follow updates!

Developed by OMG
